sections.title: Habit and life strategy
sections.text: Dictyostega orobanchoides is a non-photosynthetic mycoheterotrophic herb: it depends on associated fungi for its resources. Its whitish shoots are about 10–30 cm tall and bear tiny scale-like leaves. It grows in humid forests among leaf litter.

sections.title: Flowers and plate
sections.text: The plant produces small pale flowers and capsule fruits. The plate correctly shows an almost white shoot without green foliage among forest litter; its organs are detailed for teaching. No edibility has been verified.
